title: Water and Warmth

stage.name: Water and warmth
stage.description: Water softens the seed coat. The seed swells and begins to wake up.

intro: A seed only wakes when the conditions are right.

questions.prompt: What does a seed need to start waking up?
options: Water, the right warmth and air
questions.why: Water, a suitable temperature and oxygen start germination.

questions.prompt: Most seeds need sunlight to begin germinating underground.
questions.why: It's dark underground. The seed runs on its stored food until its leaves reach the light.

questions.prompt: Put the waking-up steps in order.
items: It swells and the coat softens
questions.why: Water comes first. Everything else follows from the seed swelling.

questions.prompt: What are the “water and warmth” of a new relationship?
options: Testing whether the other person gets jealous
Keeping score of who texted last
questions.why: Warmth and reliability make people feel safe, and feeling safe lets them open up.
